subject: Hosted evaluation: activation runbook and endpoint/rate questions
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@brightcart.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation: activation runbook and endpoint/rate questions

Hi Alice / Samir — great to meet you both on the demo earlier. Quick recap and a short activation runbook so we can scope the hosted evaluation correctly.

High-level notes from the call:
- BrightCart prefers a hosted first-pass (fast time-to-value) but has two gating items: EU data residency for logs and an SLA for 24/7 availability.
- Typical prompt lengths: ~250 tokens; occasional longer sessions up to 512 tokens.
- Expected peak concurrency: you mentioned ~700–900 rps for search/autocomplete + spikes for checkout chat.

Immediate asks so Redwood can size a sandbox and provide realistic rate guidance:
1) Confirm whether you need EU-only data residency for the evaluation (only control-plane metadata vs full request/response storage).
2) Can you share a short traffic profile (percent of requests that are short <64 tokens vs long >256 tokens)? A simple CSV is fine.
3) Which endpoints matter for you during evaluation: text-generation (chat), embeddings, and a reranking endpoint?

Attachments: I attached a short hosted-eval access matrix (hosted-eval-access-matrix.xlsx) that maps endpoints -> recommended sandbox concurrency -> observed cost per 1k tokens (est). Please review.

Proposed next steps:
- If you confirm hosted and EU residency is optional for the trial, we can provision a sandbox project and share a set of sandbox keys + a staging endpoint within 48 business hours.
- We typically recommend a 2-week hosted pilot with an agreed token budget and two SRE syncs (kickoff + pre-cutover).
- If peak concurrency stays >1500 rps or you require on-prem, we should discuss Dedicated / Private options — I flagged this for Ben to size.

Would you be able to send the traffic CSV and confirm residency today/tomorrow? I can then loop in Engineering/SRE and get the sandbox spun up.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0149

---
Attachment: hosted-eval-access-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 12KB)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice@brightcart.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightcart.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 17:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: activation runbook and endpoint/rate questions

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the clear runbook. Quick answers below and attached our security questionnaire.

- Residency: For the pilot we can accept hosted with data processed in US-only, but any production rollout will need EU residency options. So for the sandbox US-hosted is OK as long as logs are not retained long-term.
- Traffic profile (attached): peak target ~900 rps (95th), baseline ~120 rps. About 70% of requests are short (<64 tokens), ~25% mid-length (64–256), ~5% long (>256).
- Endpoints: primary is chat/text-generation for checkout assist, secondary is embeddings for recommendations, and a small reranker used in search.

We attached BrightCart_Security_Questionnaire.pdf with a few SOC/ISO questions — let us know what you can answer off the bat. Also: what is the default per-key concurrency and burst allowance for the hosted sandbox? We need to model client-side backoff.

Appreciate the 48hr sandbox turnaround if possible.

Alice Nguyen
Head of Product, BrightCart
alice@brightcart.com

---
Attachment: BrightCart_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation: activation runbook and endpoint/rate questions

Looping in Marissa for pricing/credits. Quick sizing / recommendation based on Alice's traffic CSV:

Summary of proposal:
- Sandbox provisioning: we can stand up a US-hosted sandbox project with staging endpoint: https://api.sandbox.redwood.com/projects/brightcart (configured for three endpoints: chat, embeddings, rerank).
- Default per-key concurrency: 100 concurrent token-generation streams; burst policy: 2x baseline for short windows (configurable). For the pilot, recommend we pre-allocate a traffic slice of 1,000 rps burst capacity to avoid early throttling while we tune batching.
- Cost and token budget: estimated ~1.6 million tokens/week at projected profile; recommend a 2-week pilot with a 4M token cap.
- Residency note: since production requires EU residency, document that the hosted trial will not fulfill a production EU commitment; Dedicated or Private will be required for EU data residency and guaranteed local storage.

Pilot commercial ask:
- Offer: 20% pilot credit on top of free credits (to be applied to the 4M token cap) and a waived setup fee.
- Conditions: BrightCart provides the traffic CSV and agrees to two SRE syncs (kickoff + pre-cutover).

Next operational steps (can be executed once Marissa greenlights credits):
1) Legal: draft a short pilot addendum (DocuSign link to follow).
2) Solutions/SRE: schedule a 60m deep-dive next-week to walk the sandbox endpoints and rate-limiting model.
3) Engineering: provision the sandbox and share keys within 48 business hours of addendum signature.

Marissa — can you approve the 20% pilot credit and waive the setup fee? If yes, I will send the addendum and SRE calendar invite.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (650) 555-0192
